t: Charlie Marsh: uv: An Extremely Fast Python Package Manager

q.x: Extremely interesting presentation from Charlie Marsh about all the optimizations [link]

desc:
Charlie Marsh is the founder of Astral, which develops uv, a next-generation Python package manager written in Rust. In this talk, Charlie details the unique challenges of the Python packaging ecosystem and how he made uv so fast: allocators, concurrency, zero-copy tricks, and more.

You can find the transcript for this video and other Tech Talks here: https://www.janestreet.com/tech-talks/index.h

I suppose the mentioned talk[0] (even though it's more than a year old now) would serve as a better technical report.
